title: Service Proof Loop
summary: Send visit proof and carry approved extras into the next recurring visit.
user: Recurring cleaning and maintenance businesses that need post-job proof, client feedback, and approved extras to flow into the next visit without building a custom customer portal.
smallest_useful_product: Technician upload/checklist, client proof page, one-tap accept/problem/rating, configurable extras, and automatic attachment to the next recurring job export.
success_measure: At least 40% of completed recurring jobs receive a client response within 48 hours and 80% of requested extras arrive on the next job card without staff re-entry.
monetization: $59 per business each month plus technician seats
